title: PETRI: Living Lineages
description: A living pond of evolving organisms. Inspect their anatomy, inherited genes, and family histories.
imageAlt: PETRI pond with organism populations and a Mixo anatomy inspector.
note: Recovered v05 web app and v01–v04 releases from the ChatGPT project files. The main entry is the v05 web build. Download the complete modular source from `downloads/`. See [QA notes](QA.md) for prior validation and device limitations. The screenshot is the supplied v05 release capture. The web manifest and service worker use relative scope, so this app is contained within `/petri/living-lineages/`.

title: Inkstar
description: Cartoon spaceflight with procedural destinations, trading, missions, and a shipyard.
imageAlt: Inkstar landed at the oceanic garden world Verdania with port services.
note: The gallery starts the recovered standalone polish demo. `versions/github-fleet/` preserves the former GitHub homepage, its loader, renderer, and zero-cost ship/paint behavior byte for byte. Earlier unused runtime scripts are in `versions/earlier-runtime/`. The thumbnail is the supplied polish-demo capture.

title: Inkdrift
description: Pilot a small cartoon ship through a procedural asteroid field and land on illustrated worlds.
imageAlt: Inkdrift spacecraft among asteroids in a blue and purple starfield.
note: Recovered standalone tech demo from the ChatGPT project files. The screenshot is the supplied spaceflight capture.

title: Nebula Weave
description: Grow nebulae from Wave Function Collapse patterns, with filaments, dust lanes, and shifting palettes.
imageAlt: Blue procedural nebula with glowing filaments, dark dust lanes, and WFC controls.
note: The standalone recovered build is `index.html`. The original six-part GitHub build remains in `versions/github-split/`; serve it over HTTP so its script fetches can work. The screenshot is the supplied standalone-demo capture.

title: Petri Classic
description: The original petri-dish experiments in population, diet, evolving traits, and radiation.
imageAlt: Green colonies and multicolored organisms in the classic Petri simulation.
note: `index.html` is the original freeze 09 scalar file, unchanged. Earlier freezes are under `versions/`. Root-level historical HTML addresses redirect to their corresponding preserved builds. Preview captured from the same original scalar build on 2026-09-26.

title: Radio chatter
description: Simulated radio conversations with synthesized voices, environmental context, and experimental local language models.
imageAlt: Radio chatter interface with start and stop controls and a generated Bravo transmission.
note: The recommended start is scripted `versions/tts_09.html`. All original snapshots live under `versions/`, and their old root URLs redirect to them. Language-model variants retain their original CDN/model dependencies; they have not been revalidated. Preview captured from tts_09 on 2026-09-27.

title: Planetside
description: A procedural planet workbench with terrain, grid, lighting, and rendering controls.
note: The repository root is this single project’s directory. The original runtime is unchanged. WebGL is required; a working graphics screenshot is still pending because the capture browser cannot create a WebGL context.
